changes.value: extend the descriptor block from 7 to ~40 RDKit 2D descriptors (Crippen molar refs, Chi/penalised LogP, BCH, FpDensityMorgan1-3, EState_VSA counts); feature dim 2048+7 -> 2048+40

hypothesis: A richer physical descriptor block improves per-target locked-test AUROC by >=0.005 on at least two of MOR/KOR/DRD2 without dropping any target by more than 0.02.

acceptance.equivalence: not byte-comparable: this candidate changes the feature space, so equivalence is metric-level

evaluation_protocol: for each target: featurize(train+val with new descriptors) -> ml.train --split-manifest -> evaluator on locked test; compare against the frozen per-target baselines (MOR 0.9339 / KOR 0.8685 / DRD2 0.9015)
risk: more descriptors = more noise per row; xgboost may need depth tuning later (out of scope here); descriptor computation cost ~2x
basis: docs/PHASE4_DESIGN.md shadow protocol; science_007 trace as the replay baseline
note: metric-level candidate: artifact byte/npz equivalence does NOT apply (feature space changes by design); the shadow report must record AUROC deltas instead
verdict: ACCEPTED by point estimate (2 targets >= +0.005, no target drops); all CIs contain 0 — directional pass, NOT a significant improvement; promotion decision (make v2 default) deferred to operator
